status: CONFIRMED bounded source review; full acceptance remains pending

findings: Decoded starts are deduplicated and constrained to complete function bodies. Token anchors require the emitted row line to match that function token; visibility follows emitted sequences.
Whole-program source totals use unions; missing instruction/token evidence suppresses the applicable percentage.
Recovered variables are joined to successful producer declarations; filtered declarations retain a denominator and omission reason.
Known scope derives from formal/lexical evidence, never location-list extent. Unknown scope remains explicit. Location ranges intersect owner and known complete scope.
Producer facts contain immutable Java snapshots, with no escaping native pointers.
Canonical type reachability is iterative and cycle-safe. Repeated reference counts govern completeness; allocated but unattached nodes cannot complete a function.
Variable correspondence uses declared bindings without inferred lineage. Coverage gains/losses use common known scope; raw interval and provenance changes remain separate.
Nested readers share whole-document and scoped legacy/coverage budgets. The lexical guard bounds bytes, strings and depth before Gson token growth.
Schema-one coverage is forbidden; schema-two coverage is required. Terminal reports cannot carry completed coverage/artifact claims. Validation remains NOT_RUN.
The selected report is the only opened input; artifact strings do not authorize or perform attachment.
Report save uses a staged same-filesystem hard link with create-if-absent semantics; existing paths are never replaced.
GUI file parsing/comparison runs in a SwingWorker, with cancellation and no partial result publication. Display saturation preserves exact change counting.
Dialog size and location are constrained to usable desktop bounds.
The scorecard observes the exact serialized line/location plans and type branches after successful producer calls.

The location-list prefilter simplification preserves behavior: at most one range cannot change storage, and an all-unavailable list yields no plan. Available ranges still require successful full-value expression planning.
Producer completion releases native resources before immutable emission evidence escapes; existing finally cleanup remains in place.
Coverage assembly, serialization and strict readback occur while both artifacts are staged, before publication. Companion and attachment-preparation paths use the same source/report staging writer.
Presentation runs after successful publication; GUI presentation exceptions cannot claim the completed artifacts failed.

scope: Bounded source reviews of metric semantics, emission integration, report admission/publication and presentation. Extended review found and corrected the presentation defect recorded separately. Full architecture acceptance and current-head protected integration remain required.
validation: Initial source review changed documentation only. Extended review produced the presentation correction and meaningful regressions recorded in coverage-final-review-fixes.json. Component/packaged checks pass locally; full corrected hosted acceptance remains pending.

extendedReview.scope: Follow-up source review at the same parent plus the presentation correction; exact files recorded below. This does not replace the required runtime gates.
findings: Listing inventory uses actual Ghidra starts and matching body ranges; unavailable or ambiguous extraction does not retain partial denominators.
Decoder recomputes point unions, variable range intersections and per-kind totals; type graph evidence recomputes function/union states and validates attached roots.
Serializer preserves ordered evidence dictionaries and exact scalar strings, bounds UTF-8 including split surrogate pairs, and rejects malformed strings before publication.

Comparison limits source gains/losses to common decoded populations; canonical type keys are correspondence rather than historical lineage. CLI opens selected reports only and neutralizes terminal controls.
Presentation review found an unknown-variable-inventory defect, now covered by a failing-before/passing-after regression and corrected. See coverage-final-review-fixes.json.
Source token snapshots are captured before declaration-line merging; the array identity correction affects transient arrays while retaining persisted named type IDs.
